propositions: Ticking acceptance-criteria checkboxes does not invalidate a plan-review attestation because checkbox state is normalized out of the material basis by _normalize_checkbox_state before hashing

Current attestation staleness messages recite a fixed fictional list ('description/AC/file_impact/children') that does not match the actual four basis keys and never indicates which component actually changed

The material basis is a composite SHA256 over exactly four keys (ticket_id, description, file_impact, children, plus file_impact_scope when scope is none), and AC is not a component—acceptance criteria live inside description

Per-component fingerprints must be stored in the signed manifest as additive material-part lines rather than reconstructed at read time, because children is derived from other tickets' state at read time and could disagree with what was reviewed
Attestation staleness verdicts must name the specific changed components and their before/after counts in a standardized format rather than using a generic fixed list
